user.title: Connect charger entities
user.description: Choose the Home Assistant entities Charge Wise will monitor and control, and the current limits.

data_description.grid_power_entity: Positive values mean grid import and negative values mean export. Power units W, kW, or mW are accepted.
data_description.charger_power_entity: The charger's measured power draw. Power units W, kW, or mW are accepted.
data_description.charger_switch_entity: The switch Charge Wise uses to enable or stop charging.
data_description.current_target_entity: A writable number entity for the active charging-current limit, in amperes.
data_description.hardware_maximum_entity: Optional read-only hardware limit. The configured safe maximum still applies if this entity is unavailable.
data_description.minimum_current_a: The lowest current Charge Wise may request, in amperes.
data_description.maximum_current_a: Required safe ceiling used even when no hardware maximum entity is selected.
data_description.voltage_v: Single-phase voltage used to convert available power to current.
data_description.charger_status_entity: Optional binary connection sensor (on means connected, off means disconnected), or charger status sensor interpreted using the selected profile. Binary sensors do not report session status.
data_description.charger_status_profile: For status sensors: Automatic recognizes the supplying OCPP or Wallbox integration. Otherwise select a profile or Custom. Ignored for binary sensors.
data_description.charger_states_disconnected: For the Custom profile only: enter each exact sensor value meaning disconnected. Leave ambiguous values unmapped. Idle means connected and waiting; finished means the session explicitly ended.
data_description.charger_states_idle: For the Custom profile only: enter each exact sensor value meaning idle. Leave ambiguous values unmapped. Idle means connected and waiting; finished means the session explicitly ended.
data_description.charger_states_charging: For the Custom profile only: enter each exact sensor value meaning charging. Leave ambiguous values unmapped. Idle means connected and waiting; finished means the session explicitly ended.
data_description.charger_states_paused: For the Custom profile only: enter each exact sensor value meaning paused. Leave ambiguous values unmapped. Idle means connected and waiting; finished means the session explicitly ended.
data_description.charger_states_finished: For the Custom profile only: enter each exact sensor value meaning finished. Leave ambiguous values unmapped. Idle means connected and waiting; finished means the session explicitly ended.
data_description.charger_states_fault: For the Custom profile only: enter each exact sensor value meaning fault. Leave ambiguous values unmapped. Idle means connected and waiting; finished means the session explicitly ended.
data_description.charger_current_entity: Optional measured current sensor in A for the dashboard. Without it, the gauge shows measured charging power. Do not select an offered current or current-limit sensor.

solar.title: Solar charging
solar.description: When Solar charging starts and stops, and how finely the current is adjusted.

data.settle_hold_s: Settle time after a current change
data.go_back: Go back to the previous page

data_description.solar_start_w: Minimum available solar power required to start charging.
data_description.low_solar_confirmation_s: How long available solar power may remain below the minimum before charging stops.
data_description.cooldown_s: Minimum wait after stopping or restoring a mode before Solar can restart.
data_description.current_deadband_a: Ignore smaller current changes to avoid unnecessary charger commands.
data_description.settle_hold_s: After changing the current, wait this long before changing it again so the charger and its power reading catch up. 0 turns it off.
data_description.smoothing_window_s: Average the available solar power over this window so brief house loads do not move the charger. 0 turns it off.
data_description.native_solar_entity: Optional. Choose the charger's solar-mode dropdown to let it manage solar charging.
data_description.native_solar_option: The exact dropdown option for full-solar charging.
data_description.native_solar_off_option: The exact dropdown option that disables the charger's solar mode.
data_description.native_solar_release_percent: End the full-battery handoff below this battery level unless battery-first mode still applies.
data_description.go_back: Tick this and select Next or Submit to return to the previous page. Values on this page are kept.

battery.title: Battery protection
battery.description: Optionally pause charging when the home battery discharges too much. Leave the sensor empty to skip protection.

data.go_back: Go back to the previous page

data_description.battery_power_entity: Optional battery power sensor. Omitting it disables battery-discharge protection.
data_description.battery_discharge_sign: Choose whether battery discharge is reported as positive or negative power.
data_description.battery_discharge_w: Battery discharge above this level starts the protection confirmation timer.
data_description.battery_recovery_w: Battery discharge must remain below this level before protection can clear.
data_description.battery_confirmation_s: How long battery discharge must exceed its threshold before protection activates.
data_description.battery_recovery_confirmation_s: How long battery discharge must remain below its recovery threshold before protection clears.
data_description.go_back: Tick this and select Next or Submit to return to the previous page. Values on this page are kept.

forecast.title: EV-first charging
forecast.description: Optionally let the EV use power that would charge the home battery when the solar forecast covers the battery's need. Set the four inputs together or leave them empty.

data.go_back: Go back to the previous page

data_description.forecast_remaining_entity: Optional energy sensor (Wh, kWh or MWh) with the forecast solar energy still to come today, such as Forecast.Solar.
data_description.forecast_today_entity: Optional energy sensor (Wh, kWh or MWh) with the forecast for the whole of today. With it, Charge Wise compares the forecast so far with the solar energy actually produced and scales the rest of the day's forecast by that accuracy. Without it the forecast is used as given.
data_description.battery_level_entity: Optional sensor reporting the home battery charge in percent.
data_description.solar_energy_entity: Optional cumulative solar energy sensor (Wh, kWh or MWh), such as the one used by the Energy dashboard. When set, the forecast accuracy compares the whole day's production with the forecast instead of integrating the power sensor.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable home battery capacity. EV-first charging needs this together with the three sensors above.
data_description.battery_target_percent: The battery level the forecast must still be able to reach by sunset.
data_description.ev_first_release_margin_percent: Extra forecast surplus above the battery's need required to start EV-first sharing. Sharing ends at or below full battery coverage; battery-first charging may still use grid-export surplus. 0 removes the extra sharing buffer.
data_description.house_load_window_days: How many days of history the learned consumption averages follow. Shorter adapts faster.
data_description.solar_power_entity: Optional sensor (mW, W or kW) with the current solar production. Charge Wise subtracts export and battery charging and adds the grid and battery power it already reads to work out house consumption, then learns the average per hour of day.
data_description.go_back: Tick this and select Next or Submit to return to the previous page. Values on this page are kept.

offpeak.title: Off-peak windows and dashboard
offpeak.description: Set up to three windows when Off-peak charging may use the grid. Leave start and end empty to skip a window.

data.go_back: Go back to the previous page

data_description.offpeak_window_1_start: Leave start and end empty to skip this window.
data_description.offpeak_window_1_end: Windows may cross midnight, for example 23:00 to 06:00.
data_description.offpeak_window_1_days: Days the window applies to, counted from the day it starts.
data_description.offpeak_window_2_start: Optional. Leave start and end empty to skip this window.
data_description.offpeak_window_3_start: Optional. Leave start and end empty to skip this window.
data_description.create_dashboard: Adds a Charge Wise dashboard to the sidebar with this charger's controls and status. Untick to remove it.
data_description.go_back: Tick this and select Next or Submit to return to the previous page. Values on this page are kept.

error.already_configured: This charger control is already used by another Charge Wise entry.
error.entity_not_found: One or more selected entities do not currently exist.
error.invalid_battery_thresholds: The battery recovery threshold must be lower than the discharge threshold.
error.invalid_entity: Choose an entity from the required domain and use a different number for the current target and hardware maximum.
error.invalid_hardware_limit: The hardware maximum must be a valid current limit at or above the minimum operating current.
error.invalid_limits: The maximum current must be at least the minimum operating current.
error.native_solar_incomplete: Choose the charger solar-mode dropdown and both option values, or leave all three empty.
error.native_solar_invalid_options: The full-solar and off values must be different options provided by the selected dropdown.
error.native_solar_release_required: Turn off Charging enabled and wait for the charger and its solar mode to turn off before changing the charger control.
error.invalid_power_unit: Power sensors must report mW, W, or kW.
error.offpeak_window_incomplete: Set both the start and the end of an off-peak window, or clear both.
error.offpeak_window_empty: An off-peak window cannot start and end at the same time.
error.invalid_energy_unit: The forecast sensor must report Wh, kWh, or MWh.
error.ev_first_incomplete: Set the forecast, battery level, house consumption and battery capacity together, or leave all four empty.
error.invalid_status_mapping: Enter at least one custom status. Values must be unique across all groups and cannot be unknown or unavailable.
error.status_profile_required: The supplying integration is not recognized. Select OCPP, Wallbox or Custom for this status sensor.
error.invalid_current_unit: Select a current target and any measured current sensor reporting amperes (A).
error.invalid_current_range: Select a current target whose range covers the configured minimum and maximum and whose step supports every whole-amp value between them.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: Add or update vehicle status cards. These readings only affect the dashboard. Choose Save vehicles to apply your changes.

vehicle_add.title: Add vehicle
vehicle_add.description: Choose existing Home Assistant readings. Leave optional readings empty to hide them. Remove a selected reading to stop displaying it. Changes apply when you choose Save vehicles.

data_description.name: Name shown on this vehicle’s dashboard card.
data_description.battery_entity: Required vehicle battery sensor reporting a percentage.
data_description.charge_target_entity: Optional sensor or number reporting the target percentage. Select a number to change the target from the dashboard; sensors are read-only.
data_description.connected_entity: Optional binary sensor: on means the vehicle is plugged in.
data_description.charging_entity: Optional binary sensor: on means the vehicle is charging.
data_description.charging_power_entity: Optional power sensor reporting W or kW.
data_description.range_entity: Optional remaining range sensor reporting km, mi or m.
data_description.time_remaining_entity: Optional remaining charging duration sensor reporting seconds, minutes or hours.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Optional usable battery capacity in kWh. Requires a selected charging power sensor. Estimates time to the charge target (100% if no target is selected) when the vehicle has no valid time remaining. Assumes constant power and excludes charging losses and tapering. Clear to disable estimates.
